en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from one of his companions, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman Al Asamma, from Haydara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Jihad is the most superior of the things (deeds) after (fulfilling) the Obligations’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from certain individuals of his people from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman al-Asamm from Haydarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Jihad (serving in the army) is the most virtuous task except obligatory (prayers) matters.”
